name: 76116 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76116 (Fort Worth) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76116 (Fort Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76116 (Fort Worth) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
